query:
query ContentListing($families: [String!]!, $limit: Int!, $page: Int!, $taxonomySlug: String, $listingState: String, $publishedBefore: String, $startAfter: String, $onlineOnly: Boolean, $sort: String) {
  contentListing(
    families: $families
    limit: $limit
    page: $page
    taxonomySlug: $taxonomySlug
    listingState: $listingState
    publishedBefore: $publishedBefore
    startAfter: $startAfter
    onlineOnly: $onlineOnly
    sort: $sort
  ) {
    success
    message
    data {
      items {
        ...PublicContentEntryFields
        __typename
      }
      total
      page
      limit
      hasMore
      __typename
    }
    __typename
  }
}

fragment PublicContentEntryFields on PublicContentEntry {
  id
  family
  slug
  canonicalPath
  legacyPaths
  title
  teaser
  teaserImage
  cardEyebrow
  cardMeta
  cardCtaLabel
  listingState
  navVariant
  footerVariant
  navCta
  body
  seo
  taxonomyTerms
  publishedAt
  lastPublishedAt
  updatedAt
  __typename
}
